canDo: Turn recurring errors into actionable personal rules and replacement chunks.
review: Sort the Error Book by frequency.
input: A new example sentence / new context for each error.
output: Rewrite / re-say the 20 most frequent ones.
checkpoint: Each error has a closed loop: “error → rule → correct example → new example”.
challenge: Today’s challenge: sort out your Error Book: rank the top 5 errors by frequency, turn each into an actionable “personal rule” (e.g. « Après si, jamais de conditionnel ») with a French chunk you can reuse as is; then do 5 matching exercises for each at Le Point du FLE to check whether the rule really helps you avoid the error.
